experiments.name: Compact KDA versus Complex KDA ECG encoder
experiments.primary_comparison: CKDA minus KDA; same parameters except the specified transition ranges. GRU is a practical reference with reported capacity.
experiments.learning: Train fresh compact ECG encoders with a common causal waveform stem and the same CPC objective. Copy the initial stem and prediction heads across arms.
experiments.starting_budget: Twenty SSL epochs fail the measured two-hour gate; choose a shorter matched budget only after end-to-end profiling of SSL, development evaluation and both label budgets.
experiments.next_action: Build a resumable three-arm end-to-end runner using the verified exact-float32 GPU staging path, then profile the complete protocol and freeze a shorter matched budget in a successor manifest. The completed profile is cost-only; no comparative ECG model result exists yet.
constraints: No language-model checkpoint required.
Do not warm-start only the GRU arm from its trained checkpoint.
CKDA audio evidence is a limited toy and GRU was strongest there.
Profile correctness and memory on V100; theoretical efficiency does not guarantee kernel compatibility.

experiments.learning: Train a new compact raw-ECG model using the common causal CPC objective; preserve source input-dependent filtering mechanisms.
experiments.starting_budget: Proposed same fixed pool, 20 SSL epochs and both label budgets as 011; exact architecture and budget remain to be frozen.
experiments.next_action: Pin source operator definitions; design small explicit/implicit filters and a matched local control; test causal padding, FFT wrap prevention, gradients and resumability.
constraints: No billion-parameter Evo checkpoint or DNA vocabulary.
Describe as an adaptation, not an exact Evo 2 reproduction.
Short ECG token sequences may remove the long-context advantage.
